mutations.name: Polymorph
mutations.reason: Keep one mechanical Polymorph choice in the classless draft. Turtle, Pig, Black Cat, Rabbit and Turkey variants are cosmetic/collection variants of the same crowd-control role and must not consume separate card slots if they are present in source data.

mutations.name: Slow Fall
mutations.reason: Slow Fall stays a standalone utility card but should be self-contained in the classless draft. Remove the native Light Feather reagent requirement instead of making a random level-1 draft choice depend on stocking a legacy consumable.

mutations.name: Conjure Mana Gem
mutations.description: Conjura un Zafiro de maná con 3 cargas. Cada carga restaura una cantidad de maná ajustada al nivel del personaje.
mutations.reason: Collapse the native Mana Gem rank progression into one rankless choice. The runtime card adopts the level-77 Mana Sapphire create/recharge behavior while the Sapphire's direct Replenish Mana spell is replaced by deterministic helper 242987. Its min/max restoration curve reproduces every WotLK gem rank, uses the same level-offset rule below the first native rank, preserves native random ranges, and stays flat from the last native rank through level 80. The helper is executed through canonical custom_spell_scaling.tsv, not a parallel scaling engine.

mutations.name: Arcane Intellect
mutations.description: Aumenta el Intelecto de todos los miembros del grupo y banda en $s1 durante $d.
mutations.reason: Keep Arcane Intellect identity/icon and normalized scaling, but use Arcane Brilliance group/raid targeting and a fixed one-hour runtime duration. The explicit runtime duration is required because normalized scaling otherwise reapplies Arcane Intellect's original 30-minute duration at cast time. Arcane Brilliance is no longer a separate draft card.

mutations.name: Ice Armor
mutations.reason: Ice Armor is the single retained choice for the Frost Armor/Ice Armor progression. Frost Armor is an inferior earlier parallel family for this draft design and must stay out even after the temporary audit whitelist is disabled.

mutations.name: Molten Armor
mutations.reason: Molten Armor's reactive fire damage is executed by the separate ranked helper family rooted at 34913. The normalized armor must trigger the normalized helper so that reactive damage follows the same player-level scaling pipeline instead of dealing the native level-62 value at level 1. The helper remains internal and is never offered as a standalone draft card.

mutations.name: Conjure Refreshment
mutations.reason: Conjure Refreshment is the single Mage food/drink utility card. Separate Conjure Food and Conjure Water choices are redundant once one refreshment restores both health and mana, and Ritual of Refreshment remains excluded. The created Mana Pie uses reviewed internal helper clones wired into the canonical custom_spell_scaling.tsv. Level 65/74/80 anchors reproduce Mana Biscuit, Mana Pie and Mana Strudel values; level 1 uses the same low-level offset rule as normalized combat spells.
